units.training_cost: GPU process wall seconds; concurrent process times are added

definitions.training_episode_length: Mean of the latest100 recorded episode_length_epoch/all scalar samples. RSI random-reference-start episodes use their training curriculum thresholds.
definitions.RSI_success: Mean of latest100 episode_epoch/success_rate scalar samples; not frame0 whole-task success.
definitions.forced_full_control_steps: Evaluation suppresses early reset and covers the reference timeline; this is coverage, not natural survival.
definitions.evaluation_internal_first_failure: First retained internal failure flag with extra object threshold multiplier1, tightening curricula disabled; distinct from active training allowance4. Control step is1-based.
definitions.common_object_position_first_exceed: First control step with either object position error>.02/.343m (58.309mm), gated by running_progress>=8; separate from all-cause internal failure.
definitions.reference_position_error: Simulated object pose error against the selected predicted reconstruction reference; not independent GT error.
definitions.sustained_lift: Actual z rise from first control_post state, averaged where reference z rise exceeds half of its own maximum rise. A large maximum alone can reflect an overshoot.
definitions.half_reference_fraction: Within that reference-high interval, fraction of actual z rise greater than half of the same-frame reference rise.
definitions.paper_success: Both objects must pass translation0.10m and rotation1.0rad at every original RGB frame; single-object passes and physical lift are separate.
definitions.GT_alignment: Shared fixed-scale SE3 alignment of both object centroids; per-object first-common-frame orientation offset.
definitions.Appendix_C_rollout: Object ATE/ARE per source frame; RTE/RRE per adjacent source-frame pair. Reconstruction10 metrics remain in the reconstruction audit.
definitions.source_row_index: First failed or missing source row is0-based; control-step first failure is1-based.
definitions.selection_boundary: checkpoint trajectories frozen before GT scoring; final choices owned by GT-blind trainer; main900 reused its earlier frozen-stage breakthrough score after it was selected as final best; cut900/brush900 scored after final best freeze

Mean RH height during reference-high ROI34.68→43.19mm vsreference35.83mm; absolute height error7.17→7.36mm gives no following improvement. control_plan.basis: Rotation reward exp(-3theta), weight1 and 30deg/0.343*scale^3 termination already match public upstream. Distal source is already C3. Compare two residual scales and existing upstream net-force scope.
control_plan.continuation_rule: 900 always after600; 1200 only if GT-free error, sustained lift or episode length improves; no variant beyond1200
control_plan.adoption_rule: brush sustained right lift gain >10mm, half-reference lift fraction >10%, paired error lower than C3; main/cut paired error degradation <=2mm and sustained lift degradation <=2mm. Otherwise retain unified C3.
